title: [Autour de La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois, pages 1 à 67] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (inferred from the neighbouring pages; Galois-theoretic study of sections, 'Longue Marche' context). K is a field of finite type over Q, the function field of a model S. U_K is a hyperbolic curve over K which may extend over S to an 'elementary relative scheme' (an Artin-neighbourhood-type fibration) X/S. E_{U_K} = π_1(U_K) is an extension of E_K = Gal(K̄/K) by the geometric fundamental group π. E_K in turn maps onto E_Q = Γ_Q with kernel the geometric part.

Opening lines. These conclude the previous page's discussion of how sections specialize at points of the divisors D_α. That question is set aside because at the remaining points it is no longer a question about global relative sections. It concerns 'éléments de sections' relatifs: sections of the formal completion of X/S along a section, together with that distinguished section as part of the structure. Grothendieck judges this of less burning interest.

New start. Take a section of E_{U_K} → E_K 'of the first type', i.e. coming from a K-rational point f_K of U_K. This gives (29) φ = f_{K*} : E_K → E_{U_K}. The point is that this is intrinsic, independent of any choice of model S over which U_K extends as an elementary relative scheme.

Then for any section s of E_K → E_Q = Γ_Q, or of its restriction to an open subgroup Γ' ⊂ Γ_Q, the composite φ∘s is a section of E_{U_K} over Γ'. As the next page says, this yields actions of Γ' on π (genuine actions, not just outer actions).

The next page generalizes this to subfields K' ⊂ K. Grothendieck wants an overall view of this family of sections and wants to compare it with the sections E_{K(s)} → E_{X_s} obtained by specializing to closed or residual points s of S.

In modern terms: sections of Gal(K) → Gal(Q) for a function field K play the role of 'birational/Galois-theoretic points' of S over number fields. Composing with the section attached to a rational point transports them to sections of π_1(U_K) over open subgroups of Γ_Q. This organizes rational points of a fibration into compatible families of Galois sections, a prelude to comparing generic and special fibres.
errors: No mathematical error. The composition of sections is formally correct. The claim that the construction is independent of the model S is justified because φ depends only on f_K and the base point.

ideas.what: Section of π_1(U_K) → Gal(K) attached to a K-rational point of a hyperbolic curve
ideas.modern_name: Kummer/section map of the section conjecture
ideas.where_published: Letter to Faltings (1983); Esquisse d'un programme

ideas.what: Composing with sections of Gal(K) → Gal(Q) (or of an open subgroup Γ') to get sections of π_1(U_K) over Γ', hence genuine Γ'-actions on π
ideas.modern_name: Functoriality of Galois sections; birational section conjecture for function fields (sections of Gal(K) → Gal(k))
ideas.usually_credited_to: birational version studied by Koenigsmann, Pop, Stix (2000s)

ideas.what: Local 'elements of sections': sections of the formal completion of a relative curve X/S along a section, with that section as part of the structure
ideas.modern_name: Formal/local Galois sections, specialization of sections at bad points
ideas.usually_credited_to: Stix's work on specialization of sections

missed.claim: Grothendieck raises, then explicitly sets aside, the study of how sections specialize at points of the boundary divisors where the associated rational section of the normal bundle degenerates. He reformulates it as a problem about sections of the formal completion of X/S along a section.
missed.quote: pour des "éléments de sections" relatifs — savoir, pour le complété formel d'une section relative X/S le long d'une section
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is a local or formal version of section specialization at degenerate points. The topic has been treated only partially in later work on specialization of Galois sections; it is a minor lead.

deep.surprise_reason: The material is formal: composing the rational-point section with sections of Gal(K) → Gal(Q). It fits known section-conjecture themes. The only mildly notable item is a brief, abandoned suggestion about formal 'elements of sections'.
transcription_corrections: 'Σ' throughout should be 'E' (E_{U_K}, E_K, E_Q = Γ_Q), consistent with the next page.
Line 1 likely reads 'plus une question pour des sections relatives globales'.
'la complétion formelle' is likely 'le complété formel'.

'(indépendamment de ce que le modèle S de K ou la donnée d'un modèle...)' likely reads 'indépendamment du choix d'un modèle S de K sur lequel U_K pourrait déjà se définir comme schéma relatif élémentaire'.
'(29) f_{K,x} = φ' should read 'f_{ξ_K} = φ : E_K → E_{U_K}' (or f_{K*}).
'par la section de Σ_K sur Σ_Q = Γ_Q ... sur un sous-groupe ouvert Γ'' likely reads 'pour toute section de E_K sur E_Q = Γ_Q ou sur un sous-groupe ouvert Γ' de celui-ci, une section'.
'section du premier type' plausibly correct; 'pt rationnel ξ_K de U_K sur K'.
